Economy · India

US Russia Sanctions Bill May Impose Tariffs on India

A US bill targeting Russia may impose tariffs of up to 100% on Indian goods, according to reports. The legislation, passed by the US, has prompted India to draw a "red line" on the matter. The potential tariffs could affect Indian exports to the United States. The bill is expected to be signed into law by President Trump.
